title: Baltic Freight 1: Your first day
lead: Today is your first day as a logistics assistant at Baltic Freight in Kaunas. You meet your manager Marta, plan a delivery to Riga and visit the warehouse.
how: You work at Baltic Freight, a logistics company. Choose what you say.
Green ✓ is right. Red ✕ is not this one. You can try again and you will see what to say. Right the first time? You get a star ★.
Tap an underlined word to see what it means.

decisions.q: Good morning! I am Marta. Welcome to Baltic Freight.
good: Nice to meet you, Marta. I'm happy to be here.

decisions.q: Do you know what logistics is?
good: A little. It is moving goods from one place to another.
wrong: Yes, I have a new car.

decisions.q: When must the truck leave Kaunas?
good: On Wednesday, I think. Then it is in Riga on Thursday.

decisions.q: Jonas is late. What do we tell the customer?
good: Let's call the customer and say we are late.

decisions.q: Please stand behind the yellow line.
good: Sorry! I'm behind the line now.

wrong: Yes, it is a big box.

decisions.q: How many boxes are on the pallet?
good: Ten boxes. They are the chairs for Riga!
The warehouse. I liked scanning the boxes.
